_about: Location reference notes: what to keep, what to ignore and what the story state corrects. 'inspected' = the image was opened and checked for batch P009-P013. Exception texts are the Production Brief V03 §10 register (LOC-EX-01..14).

OLD BLUE GATE.png.name: Old Blue Gate, Mumbai lane at night
OLD BLUE GATE.png.keep: two tall riveted blue gate leaves with large gold circle inlays; stone gateposts with ivy; navy banners with gold circle emblems; the empty ring ornament above the gate; warm street lamps; parked scooters and closed shop shutter at the sides; full moon
OLD BLUE GATE.png.ignore: the white label boxes, pointer lines and the arrow (production annotations)
corrections: From V07 p6 the coloured (violet) light seam down the gate and around its arch is OFF: the gate is dark.
From V07 p7 the small ground-level emergency hatch (lower right) stands slightly open on darkness - Tez came through it (matches approved Opening art p12).
V07 p11 PN01: after the volunteer marks, the small emergency door stands open wide enough for a child.

ENTRY COURT.png.name: Entry Court inside the Gate
ENTRY COURT.png.keep: stone court with ivy-covered walls and navy banners; empty Moon Bell stand (two slender pillars, empty suspension ring, stepped round base); large ChandRush map on the wall right of the stand; archway to Lantern Street at far right; compass-star inlay in the paving; amber lamps; full moon
ENTRY COURT.png.ignore: the white label boxes and pointer lines (production annotations)
corrections: The Lantern Street archway and street beyond are DARK (no lanterns lit) until the street is repaired - the reference shows them lit.
The gate back to the outside (left) shows no violet light.
A short slack rope hangs from the empty mount (manuscript: 'its hanging rope remains').
No Moon Bell anywhere in the court; do not add labels, numbers or equations to the map.

CHANDRUSH FAIR ARIAL MASTER MAP.png.note: Overview of the fair's geography (Old Blue Gate -> Entry Court -> Empty Moon Bell Stand -> Lantern Street -> Food Street -> ...). Not referenced by any V07 panel; useful for continuity of directions.

exception_register.LOC-EX-01: Mirror area: accept approximate raster seams/counts; before repair: empty frame, loose tiles outside; after repair: completed square with one continuous full-moon reflection. Printed 81 and 9x9 and any countable teaching demonstration stay exact.
exception_register.LOC-EX-02: Cube bay and handle: accept approximate lantern counts and old control details; featured 64 and 4x4x4 teaching stays exact; a completed cube reads as solid, not a flat grid.
exception_register.LOC-EX-03: Reverse street: preserve reverse viewpoint and station order; do not recount distant details; follow the panel's foreground state and lighting.
exception_register.LOC-EX-04: Repaired street: no distant counts; show lit arches, continuous moonline, completed mirror, solid cube, lowered handle, five white repair lamps when specified.
exception_register.LOC-EX-05: Unrepaired street: distant details representative; featured five repair lamps dark, arches/moonline unlit.
exception_register.LOC-EX-06: Lift shaft: in readable teaching views 0 aligns with the street/car floor, -8 with the storage floor, equal integer intervals; one car at the stated level.
exception_register.LOC-EX-07: Lift close-up: preserve cabin/console design; featured controls, cards, rollers and LIFT lamp must match the panel.
exception_register.LOC-EX-08: Timing drums and kits: holes/pegs illustrative; featured beat labels and kit maths match; completed kits read as 15 equal trays.
exception_register.LOC-EX-09: Shutters: extra/ambiguous bay acceptable; full labelled set is 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 15, 25, 100.
exception_register.LOC-EX-10: Entry Court and street board: the court wall map is not the five-lamp repair board; keep the Moon Bell stand empty; the featured street board reads LIFT, RHYTHM, SHUTTERS, MIRROR, CUBE in that order.
exception_register.LOC-EX-11: Old Blue Gate: the overhead ring is an ornament, not the missing Moon Bell; apply the required hatch, crowd and lighting state; earlier views are dark.
exception_register.LOC-EX-12: Food Street: use architecture/counters; the panel controls shutters and displaced items.
exception_register.LOC-EX-13: Invitations: use the settings; the panel controls late-afternoon lighting, character, invitation and silver trail. NAYA = Navya.
exception_register.LOC-EX-14: Mumbai lane: use lane layout and three-way convergence; apply early-evening lighting; do not add a moon just because the reference has one.
